exclusions: Items already represented by canonical URL, platform ID, or content hash
Access-control bypass, private material, and unsafe non-public geodata
Precise current operational positions or targeting-enabling detail
definition_of_done: The assigned public-web discovery shard and UTC window were searched
Primary publications were preferred and upstream lineage was recorded
Canonical URLs, timestamps, language, quote locators, and access failures were recorded
Candidate source profiles and follow-up task proposals were persisted when justified
No final truth assessment, territorial conclusion, or report narrative was added

result.summary: Bounded public-web discovery registered three draft source profiles and four source items covering warehouse strikes, port and shipping disruption, and a paywalled parallel report. Attribution and shared upstream lineage were preserved without truth assessment.
coverage_gaps: Direct upstream statements from all named regional authorities, companies and ministries were not exhaustively registered.
One Financial Times item was limited to public metadata because full text required a subscription.
No binaries or full-text artifacts were downloaded or hashed.
Discovery records do not verify casualties, damage, military use, targeting intent or attribution.
